answer: The meadow decay curve is applied at each close, velvet records the drop, and cipher recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. Standing decays sharply after 3 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A 112 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
